title: Consolidate the two herdr clients the deletion epic left behind
description:
Found by the pwp final review (tick sx5, attempt 9). The deletion epic exists to end 'extracted means copied', yet its integrated diff ADDS a second herdr wire client.

internal/herdclient (from tick nkf, commit ed92010e) coexists with the untouched internal/herd/client. transport.go (141 lines), protocol.go (242), socketpath.go (43) and client.go (285) are byte-identical in both, differing only in package clause and error prefix. ticfac holds a third copy.

Importers of the OLD client: internal/herd/dashboard, herdtest, cmd/tk/cmd/herd_shared.go.
Importers of the NEW client: internal/herd/relay, internal/runnersconfig, herd_relay.go.

Decide one of two, do not leave both:
(a) Point dashboard and herd_shared at internal/herdclient, growing its 99-line methods.go to cover AgentList, SubscribeAgentStatus/EventStream and TerminalStatuses, then delete internal/herd/client and herdclient/doc.go's false claim that the old package 'moved to ticfac'.
(b) Delete internal/herdclient, which keeps the full ~4.4K-line execution surface in-repo and contradicts the epic's premise.

nkf's GOES list also named herd_shared.go, herdtest and internal/herd/state for deletion; all three survive. A gate cannot catch a duplicate that compiles, so add a test that fails if two herdr client packages exist.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one herdr wire client package remains in this repository, every importer builds against it, and a test fails if a second client package is reintroduced
